security_spec.violation_condition: XiangShan frontend/IFU executes a taken conditional branch whose target address is not 4-byte aligned (IALIGN=32) without raising an instruction-address-misaligned exception, OR conversely raises such an exception for an untaken branch whose target is misaligned
security_spec.vulnerability_pattern: jump_misaligned_exception OR branch_misaligned_taken_exception OR branch_misaligned_untaken_exception OR IALIGN misaligned instruction fetch check in IFU/BranchUnit
security_spec.summary: PR is purely editorial (spelling fix s/mcounterinhibit/mcountinhibit/ in normative anchors + adding explicit tags for pre-existing misaligned-branch/jump rules); the underlying tagged rules require that XiangShan's IFU/branch-unit correctly gate instruction-address-misaligned exceptions on branch-taken vs branch-untaken, and that IALIGN=16 (C extension) correctly suppresses these exceptions — a decoder-level MEPC/MCAUSE reporting error here means wrong exception priority and potential silent control-flow corruption
